description:
Common Lime (Tilia × europaea). Reduce the crown to the previous pruning points, removing approximately 2 metres of branch length. Remove basal and epicormic growth to approximately 6 metres in height. During the crown reduction works, the climbing arborist should assess the structure of the upper parts of the trunk and main scaffold stems.

Routine management of a mature Lime that has previously been crown reduced. The proposed works follow the recommendations of the Arboricultural Solutions LLP tree inspection report dated February 2025 and are intended to reduce the overall size of the tree, including the sail effect of the crown and lever length of the branches, while retaining the tree and its amenity value.

The tree is located within the rear garden of 4 Yerbury Road. The application is being made by the occupier of 6 Highwood Road with the agreement of the tree owner at 4 Yerbury Road.
